{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the revenue column is string and contains commas
print("Revenue dtype:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Example of revenue with comma:", df['revenue'].iloc[1])

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (should be 0, per documentation)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Filter to completed orders
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
